Create a replica with the following: *One of the following [[staves]] with the appropriate [[attribute]]: **[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]] **[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Weapon Master]] **[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] **[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]] **[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]] **[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]] **[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]] **[[Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Soros]], or [[Sende]] *[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] *Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]] *Perfect "[[Inscription#Don't_Think_Twice|Don't Think Twice]]" inscription ==Unique counterpart== [[Fendi's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires [[Soul Reaping]]. ==Notes== *Except for Divine Favor staves, [[Staff#Damage types of other staves|non-randomly generated]] Fast Casting, Soul Reaping, Energy Storage, and Spawning Power staves do not usually deal fire damage. ==Trivia== *The text refers to Theodore Roosevelt's [http://www.phrases.org.uk/meanings/329050.html quote], "Speak softly and carry a big stick". *When equipped, characters hold the upper part of the staff, causing the back end to touch the ground while moving, thus giving the appearance of using the stick to walk.
